[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provides tips for staying motivated to choose healthier options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Plan ahead: Review the menu online before going to the restaurant to identify healthier options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Focus on the benefits: Consider how you'll feel after eating a healthy meal versus a high-calorie one.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Treat yourself: Indulge occasionally but don't make it a habit; consider smaller portions or kids' meals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Remember your goals: Keep in mind the reasons for making healthier choices, such as improving health, losing weight, or having more energy.
